description: Planted bugs on the feature branch, and the scripted behavior of the fake vendors in the engine's end-to-end tests. A bug is present while its repro script exits 1 at the tip, or, without a script, while its anchor is in the file.

bugs.title: average_price divides by zero for an empty list
bugs.failure_case: average_price([]) raises ZeroDivisionError instead of returning a price.

bugs.title: average_stock divides by zero for an empty list
bulk_discount misses the 10 percent tier at exactly 100 items
bugs.failure_case: bulk_discount(100) returns 5, but the docstring promises 10 for 100 items or more.

bugs.title: page skips the first page of items
bugs.failure_case: page(items, 1, 3) returns items 3 to 5; callers number pages from 1, so the first three items are never shown.

bugs.title: add_item shares one tags list across calls
bugs.failure_case: Two add_item calls without tags share the default list, so the second item carries the first item's tag.

fix.replace:
def add_item(stock, name, qty, tags=None):
    """Add an item with its tags to `stock` and return `stock`."""
    tags = list(tags or [])
    tags.append(name)

bugs.title: report_path lets a report name escape the reports directory
bugs.failure_case: report_path("../../etc/passwd") points outside reports/, so write_report can overwrite any file the process can write.

bugs.title: apply_discount accepts a discount above 100 percent
